comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego is the responder and agent1 the initiator; both operate in the same direction on the same trafficway. Chosen assumptions: agent1 is ahead in the left lane and makes a rightward lateral evasive action after 1 second, representing avoidance of an unspecified prior hazard. Ego brakes when agent1 enters its lane within 14-18 m. Agent1 uses a 1-2 m target-lane clearance threshold. Speeds are m/s, distances m; brake is 0.7-0.9. Conflict opportunity only; no collision is required.
